Qolgan uch band rasmdan aniq. 4-band uchun javob NAQSH asosida berildi (Sandra butun hikoya davomida nurlar haqida so'raydi) va buni audio tasdiqlaydi.
audioRequiredUz: 2-mashqda 'listen' deyilgan. 1, 2, 3-bandlar 110-betdagi komiksdan ANIQ aniqlanadi (gap pufakchalarining dumi). 4-band esa faqat NAQSH asosida taxmin qilinadi — buni audio tasdiqlaydi. 6-mashq — tinglash va o'qish mashqi, javob talab qilmaydi.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures on p. 110, then read the sentences and circle the correct answers.
exercises.instructionUz: 110-betdagi rasmlarga qarang, so'ngra gaplarni o'qing va to'g'ri javoblarni aylantiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  B (in a jeep)
  2  A (in the evening)
  3  B (bright light)
  4  A (spaceship)


HAR BIRI — 110-BETDAN DALIL:

 1  'Sandra and David are IN A JEEP.'
    Kirish matnidan: 'Sandra and David are
    in A JEEP.'
    → B

 2  'It's 9 o'clock IN THE EVENING.'
    Kirish matnidan: 'It's 9 PM on a January
    EVENING.'
    'pm' = tushdan keyin/kechqurun.
    → A

 3  'they see a BRIGHT LIGHT in the sky'
    4-kadrdan: 'What is that BRIGHT LIGHT?'
    → B

 4  'It is a SPACESHIP.'
    7-kadrdan: 'They are taking us into the
    SPACESHIP.'
    → A


DIQQAT — 'PM' va 'AM':
  am = ertalab (00:00-11:59)
     'ante meridiem' (lotincha)
  pm = tushdan keyin va kechqurun
     (12:00-23:59)
     'post meridiem'

  '9 PM' = kechki 9 → 'in the evening'
  '9 AM' = ertalabki 9 → 'in the morning'


DIQQAT — 4-BANDDAGI 'A(N)':
  'It is a(n) .........'
  Kitob 'a(n)' deb yozgan, chunki javob
  qaysi bo'lishiga qarab artikl o'zgaradi:
     A SPACESHIP  (undosh tovush)
     AN AEROPLANE (unli tovush)

  Javob 'spaceship' bo'lgani uchun 'A'.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a jeep      = jip
  in the evening = kechqurun
  bright light = yorqin nur
  a spaceship = kosmik kema
  an aeroplane = samolyot (britancha;
                AmE: an airplane)

items.textEn: 1  Sandra and David are ................. .   A on a train   B in a jeep
items.whyUz:
110-betdagi kirish matnidan so'zma-so'z:
'Sandra and David are IN A JEEP.'

DIQQAT — PREDLOG:
  IN a car/jeep/taxi (kichik transport)
  ON a train/bus/plane (katta transport)

items.textEn: 2  It's 9 o'clock ................. .   A in the evening   B in the morning
items.whyUz:
Kirish matnidan: 'It's 9 PM on a January
EVENING.'

'PM' = tushdan keyin va kechqurun.
'AM' = ertalab.

Rasmlarda ham osmon QORONG'I — kechqurun.

items.textEn: 3  Suddenly, Sandra and David see a ........... in the sky.   A star   B bright light
items.uz: To'satdan Sandra va Devid osmonda yorqin nurni ko'rishadi.
items.whyUz:
110-bet, 4-kadr: Sandra so'raydi:
'What is that BRIGHT LIGHT?'

'a star' (yulduz) — rasmlarda yulduzlar bor,
lekin ular DOIM osmonda. 'To'satdan' ko'rilgan
narsa — YORQIN NUR.

items.textEn: 4  It is a(n) ................. .   A spaceship   B aeroplane
items.whyUz:
110-bet, 7-kadr: 'They are taking us into
the SPACESHIP.'

DIQQAT — 'A(N)':
Kitob 'a(n)' deb yozgan, chunki:
  A spaceship (undosh)
  AN aeroplane (unli)
Javob 'spaceship' → 'A'.

exercises.instructionEn: Who asked the following? First, read the questions, then listen and write S (for Sandra) or D (for David).
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagilarni kim so'radi? Avval savollarni o'qing, so'ngra tinglang va S (Sandra) yoki D (Devid) deb yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  S (Sandra)
  2  D (David)
  3  S (Sandra)
  4  S (Sandra)


HAR BIRI — 110-BETDAN DALIL:

 1  'Why are you slowing down?'
    3-kadr: SANDRA Devidga savol beradi:
    'What's the matter, David? Why are you
     slowing down?'
    KALIT: 'David' deb murojaat qilyapti —
    demak so'rovchi SANDRA.
    → S

 2  'What on earth is going on?'
    3-kadr: DEVIDNING uzun javobida:
    'I'm not. I think that there is something
     wrong with the car. It's no use, I can't
     start it. WHAT ON EARTH IS GOING ON?
     This is a new car!'
    KALIT: bu gap Devid gapirayotgan
    pufakchaning ichida.
    → D

 3  'What is that bright light?'
    4-kadr: DEVID aytadi 'Sandra, look! Up
    there, in the sky!' — demak javob
    beruvchi SANDRA:
    'What is that bright light?'
    KALIT: Devid 'Sandra' deb murojaat qilgan.
    → S

 4  'What are those flashing lights?'
    6-kadr.
    ⚠ Bu bandda gap pufakchasining 'dumi'
    rasmda ANIQ ko'rinmaydi.

    NAQSh ASOSIDA: butun hikoya davomida
    NURLAR haqida DOIM Sandra so'raydi:
       4-kadr: 'What is that BRIGHT LIGHT?'
               (Sandra)
       6-kadr: 'What are those FLASHING
               LIGHTS?'
    Devid esa hajm haqida gapiradi:
       'Look at it! It's HUGE!'

    → S
    (Audio buni tasdiqlaydi.)


⚠ 8-MAShQNING XULOSASI YORDAM BERADI:

  8-mashqdagi xulosa matnida yozilgan:
     'Then SANDRA SEES A BRIGHT LIGHT in the
      sky.'
     'DAVID ASKS SANDRA TO TAKE PICTURES.'
     'DAVID can't see anything ... and SANDRA
      can't stand the noise.'

  Ya'ni:
     nurni ko'rgan — SANDRA
     surat olishni so'ragan — DEVID
     nurdan ko'ra olmayotgan — DEVID
     shovqinga chidayolmayotgan — SANDRA

  Bu — 3-bandni ham tasdiqlaydi.


QAHRAMONLARNING XARAKTERI:

  SANDRA — ishonuvchan, qiziquvchan
     'Do you believe in UFOs?'
     'Some people say they have seen UFOs.'
     'What is that bright light?'
     'Where's that noise coming from?'

  DEVID — shubhali, mantiqiy
     'Not really. We're wasting our time.'
     'I'm sure there's a logical explanation.'
     'What on earth is going on?'

  Kitob ikki xil xarakterni ataylab bergan.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  the following = quyidagilar
  to ask        = so'ramoq

items.whyUz:
110-bet, 3-kadr:
'What's the matter, DAVID? Why are you
slowing down?'

KALIT: 'DAVID' deb MUROJAAT qilyapti —
demak so'rovchi SANDRA.

items.textEn: 2  What on earth is going on?
items.whyUz:
110-bet, 3-kadr — DEVIDNING uzun javobi
ichida:
'I'm not. I think that there is something
wrong with the car. It's no use, I can't
start it. WHAT ON EARTH IS GOING ON? This is
a new car!'

Bitta pufakchada — hammasi DEVIDNIKI.

110-bet, 4-kadr:
DEVID aytadi 'SANDRA, look! Up there, in the
sky!' — demak javob beruvchi SANDRA.

8-mashqdagi xulosa ham tasdiqlaydi:
'Then SANDRA SEES A BRIGHT LIGHT in the sky.'

⚠ Bu bandda gap pufakchasining 'dumi' rasmda
ANIQ ko'rinmaydi.

NAQSH ASOSIDA: butun hikoya davomida NURLAR
haqida DOIM Sandra so'raydi:
  4-kadr: 'What is that BRIGHT LIGHT?' (S)
  6-kadr: 'What are those FLASHING LIGHTS?'

Devid esa HAJM haqida gapiradi:
  'Look at it! It's HUGE!'

→ S (audio tasdiqlaydi).

exercises.instructionEn: Read the episode and answer the questions.
exercises.instructionUz: Epizodni o'qing va savollarga javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI SAVOL — BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  What time of the year is it?
    → It is January. (It is the first week of
      January.)
    (Yanvar oyi.)

 2  What is the weather like?
    → The night is warm and dry.
    (Tun iliq va quruq.)

 3  Where are Sandra and David?
    → They are in a jeep, driving through the
      fields near Myrrhee in Australia.
    (Ular jipda, Avstraliyaning Myrrhee
     shahri yaqinidagi dalalar orasida.)

 4  Why are they there?
    → They are doing some research to write a
      story about UFOs.
    (Ular NUJOlar haqida maqola yozish uchun
     tadqiqot olib borishmoqda.)

 5  What does Sandra hear?
    → She hears a noise.
    (U shovqin eshitadi.)

 6  Where is it coming from?
    → It is coming from the spaceship (the
      UFO) in the sky.
    (U osmondagi kosmik kemadan kelyapti.)


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — HAR JAVOB 110-BETDA:

  1  Kirish: 'on a JANUARY evening'
     Yana 2-kadr: 'during the FIRST WEEK OF
     JANUARY'
  2  Kirish: 'The night is WARM and DRY.'
  3  Kirish: 'in a JEEP ... through the
     FIELDS near MYRRHEE in AUSTRALIA'
  4  Kirish: 'doing some RESEARCH to write a
     STORY about UFOs'
  5  3-kadr: 'David, where's that NOISE coming
     from?'
  6  4-6-kadrlar: nur → NUJO → shovqin
     manbai kosmik kema


⚠ 6-SAVOL — MANTIQIY XULOSA:
  Hikoyada shovqinning manbai TO'G'RIDAN-
  TO'G'RI aytilmaydi, lekin ketma-ketlik aniq:

     3-kadr: shovqin eshitiladi
     4-kadr: osmonda yorqin nur ko'rinadi
     6-kadr: NUJO yaqinlashadi
     7-kadr: 'I can't stand that NOISE'

  Demak shovqin KOSMIK KEMADAN kelyapti.


⚠ 2-SAVOL — 'WHAT IS IT LIKE?':
  'What is the weather LIKE?'
  'like' bu yerda = 'qanday' ('yoqmoq' EMAS).

  Javobda 'like' TAKRORLANMAYDI:
     'The night is warm and dry.' ✓
     'It is like warm.'            ✗

  Coursebook 105-bet, 4b-mashqning 2-savoli
  ham shu edi.


⚠ 3 va 4-SAVOLLAR — PRESENT CONTINUOUS:
  Savollar 'ARE' bilan → javoblar ham
  Present Continuous da:
     'They ARE DRIVING ...'
     'They ARE DOING some research ...'


DIQQAT — 5-SAVOL, PRESENT SIMPLE:
  'What DOES Sandra HEAR?'
  → 'She HEARS a noise.'

  'hear' — his fe'li, Continuous BO'LMAYDI:
     'She hears a noise.'      ✓
     'She is hearing a noise.' ✗

  Shu kabi: see, smell, taste, feel.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  What time of the year? = yilning qaysi
                    fasli/oyi?
  What is it like? = u qanday?
  to hear         = eshitmoq
  a noise         = shovqin
  to come from    = ... dan kelmoq

Javobda 'like' TAKRORLANMAYDI.

points.en: 3  Where are Sandra and David?  —  They are in a jeep, driving through the fields near Myrrhee in Australia.

Continuous da.

points.en: 4  Why are they there?  —  They are doing some research to write a story about UFOs.

'TO write' — MAQSAD.

points.en: 5  What does Sandra hear?  —  She hears a noise.
points.uz: Sandra nima eshitadi? — U shovqin eshitadi.
points.noteUz:
3-kadr: 'David, where's that NOISE coming
from?'

'hear' — his fe'li, Continuous BO'LMAYDI:
'She HEARS' ✓ / 'She is hearing' ✗

points.en: 6  Where is it coming from?  —  It is coming from the spaceship (the UFO) in the sky.
points.uz: U qayerdan kelyapti? — U osmondagi kosmik kemadan kelyapti.
points.noteUz:
⚠ MANTIQIY XULOSA: hikoyada to'g'ridan-to'g'ri
aytilmaydi, lekin ketma-ketlik aniq:
shovqin → yorqin nur → NUJO →
'I can't stand that noise'.

exercises.instructionEn: Which of these phrases are related to the spaceship?
exercises.instructionUz: Bu iboralardan qaysilari kosmik kemaga tegishli?
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (9 ta ibora):
  small, warm and dry, bright light, huge,
  flashing lights, noise, good-looking,
  patient, land


KOSMIK KEMAGA TEGIShLI (5 ta):
  ✓ bright light    (yorqin nur)
  ✓ huge            (ulkan)
  ✓ flashing lights (miltillayotgan chiroqlar)
  ✓ noise           (shovqin)
  ✓ land            (qo'nmoq)


TEGIShLI EMAS (4 ta):
  ✗ small           — kema ULKAN, kichik emas
  ✗ warm and dry    — bu HAVO haqida
  ✗ good-looking    — bu ODAM haqida
  ✗ patient         — bu ODAM haqida


HAR BIRI — 110-BETDAN DALIL:

  BRIGHT LIGHT:
     4-kadr: 'What is that BRIGHT LIGHT?'

  HUGE:
     6-kadr: 'Look at it! It's HUGE!'

  FLASHING LIGHTS:
     6-kadr: 'What are those FLASHING LIGHTS?'

  NOISE:
     3-kadr: 'where's that NOISE coming from?'
     7-kadr: 'I can't stand that NOISE'

  LAND:
     2-kadr: 'UFOs LAND here in Myrrhee every
     year'


⚠ NEGA QOLGANLARI TEGIShLI EMAS:

  SMALL — kema ULKAN ('It's HUGE!'),
     shuning uchun 'small' ZID.

  WARM AND DRY — kirish matnida HAVO haqida:
     'The night is WARM AND DRY.'
     Kema haqida emas.

  GOOD-LOOKING — 'chiroyli' (odam haqida).
     Hikoyada umuman uchramaydi.

  PATIENT — 'sabrli' (odam haqida).
     Hikoyada umuman uchramaydi.


⚠ MAShQNING SIRI — IKKI TUZOQ:

  1) 'SMALL' — kemaga tegishli SO'Z turkumi
     (o'lcham), lekin MA'NOSI ZID.

  2) 'WARM AND DRY' — hikoyada BOR, lekin
     kema haqida EMAS (havo haqida).

  Ya'ni 'hikoyada bormi?' degan savol
  yetarli emas — 'KEMA haqidami?' deb
  so'rash kerak.


GAP TUZISh:
  'The spaceship has BRIGHT LIGHTS.'
  'The spaceship is HUGE.'
  'The spaceship has FLASHING LIGHTS.'
  'The spaceship makes a NOISE.'
  'UFOs LAND in Myrrhee every year.'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  good-looking = chiroyli (odam haqida)
  patient      = sabrli
  related to   = ... ga tegishli

pairs.whyUz:
110-bet, 4-kadr:
'What is that BRIGHT LIGHT?'

Sandra osmonda nurni ko'radi — bu kema.

110-bet, 6-kadr:
'Look at it! It's HUGE!'

⚠ Shuning uchun 'SMALL' TEGISHLI EMAS —
ma'nosi ZID.

110-bet, 6-kadr:
'What are those FLASHING LIGHTS?'

7-kadr: 'These lights are too bright.'

110-bet, 3-kadr:
'where's that NOISE coming from?'
7-kadr: 'I can't stand that NOISE.'

Shovqin manbai — kosmik kema.

110-bet, 2-kadr:
'They say UFOs LAND here in Myrrhee every
year.'

'to land' = qo'nmoq (kema/samolyot uchun).

⚠ TUZOQ: 'small' o'lcham bildiradi, lekin
kema ULKAN ('It's HUGE!').

Ma'nosi ZID — shuning uchun tegishli emas.

⚠ TUZOQ: bu ibora hikoyada BOR, lekin
KEMA haqida emas — HAVO haqida:
'The NIGHT is WARM AND DRY.'

Mashqning siri: 'hikoyada bormi?' emas,
'KEMA haqidami?' deb so'rash kerak.

'good-looking' — ODAM haqida ishlatiladi
(chiroyli, kelishgan).

Hikoyada umuman uchramaydi.

'patient' — ODAM xarakteri (sabrli).

Hikoyada umuman uchramaydi.

DIQQAT: 'a patient' (OT) = bemor — boshqa
ma'no.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct word from the list.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (7 ta):
  look, believe, start, stand, wasting,
  no use, land


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  BELIEVE
  2  STAND
  3  START
  4  NO USE
  5  WASTING
  6  LAND
  7  LOOK


HAMMASI 110-BETDAGI HIKOYADAN:

 1  'Many people BELIEVE in UFOs.'
    1-kadr: 'Do you BELIEVE IN UFOs?'
    'believe IN' — predlog 'in'.

 2  'I can't STAND this noise.'
    7-kadr: 'I can't STAND that noise.'
    'can't stand' = chiday olmaslik.

 3  'What's wrong with the car? I can't START
     it.'
    3-kadr: 'It's no use, I can't START it.'
    'to start a car' = mashinani yurgizmoq.

 4  'Don't cry. It's NO USE.'
    3-kadr: 'IT'S NO USE, I can't start it.'
    'It's no use' = foydasi yo'q.

 5  'I think we are WASTING our time.'
    1-kadr: 'I'm afraid we're WASTING our
    time.'
    'to waste time' = vaqtni behuda
    o'tkazmoq.

 6  'People say that UFOs LAND in Myrrhee.'
    2-kadr: 'They say UFOs LAND here in
    Myrrhee every year.'

 7  'What does it LOOK like?'
    5-kadr: 'It LOOKS LIKE a UFO.'
    'look like' = ... ga o'xshamoq.


⚠ GRAMMATIK KALITLAR:

  2, 3-bandlar: 'I CAN'T ...'
     modaldan keyin ASOSIY shakl:
     STAND, START ✓

  5-band: 'we ARE ...'
     'are' dan keyin -ING kerak:
     WASTING ✓ (ro'yxatda '-ing' bilan
     berilgan!)

  7-band: 'What DOES it ... like?'
     'does' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl:
     LOOK ✓ ('looks' EMAS)

  4-band: 'It's ...'
     'It's' dan keyin ot/sifat:
     NO USE ✓ (yagona ikki so'zli ibora)


⚠ 7-BAND — ENG NOZIK:
  'What DOES it LOOK like?'

  'does' allaqachon III shaxs birlikni
  ko'rsatadi, shuning uchun fe'l ASOSIY
  shaklda:
     'What does it LOOK like?'  ✓
     'What does it LOOKS like?' ✗

  Ro'yxatda 'look' (-S siz) berilgani
  shuning uchun.


⚠ 5-BAND — RO'YXATDAGI ShAKL KALIT:
  Ro'yxatda 'WASTING' (-ing bilan) berilgan.
  Demak u faqat 'are/is/am' dan keyin
  keladigan bo'shliqqa tushadi:
     'we are WASTING our time'

  Bu — ro'yxatning o'zi javobni aytib
  turishiga misol.


DIQQAT — 4-BAND, 'DON'T CRY':
  'Don't cry. It's no use.'
  = Yig'lama. Foydasi yo'q.

  'It's no use' — turg'un ibora.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to believe in = ... ga ishonmoq
  can't stand   = chiday olmaslik
  to start (a car) = yurgizmoq
  It's no use   = foydasi yo'q
  to waste time = vaqtni behuda o'tkazmoq
  to land       = qo'nmoq
  to look like  = ... ga o'xshamoq
  to cry        = yig'lamoq

commonMistake.whyUz:
KALIT: bo'shliqdan keyin 'IN' predlogi.
'to believe IN something' — turg'un birikma.

110-bet, 1-kadr:
'Do you BELIEVE IN UFOs?'

'can't STAND something' = chiday olmaslik.

110-bet, 7-kadr:
'I can't STAND that noise.'

DIQQAT: 'stand' bu yerda 'turmoq' EMAS!
'can't' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl.

items.sentence: 3  What's wrong with the car? I can't ........................... it.
items.uz: Mashinaga nima bo'ldi? Uni yura olmayapman.

'to START a car' = mashinani yurgizmoq.

110-bet, 3-kadr:
'It's no use, I can't START it.'

'can't' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl.

'It's NO USE' = foydasi yo'q (turg'un ibora).

110-bet, 3-kadr:
'IT'S NO USE, I can't start it.'

Ro'yxatdagi YAGONA ikki so'zli ibora.

⚠ GRAMMATIK KALIT: 'we ARE ...' —
'are' dan keyin -ING kerak.

Ro'yxatda 'WASTING' allaqachon '-ing' bilan
berilgan — bu kalit!

110-bet, 1-kadr:
'I'm afraid we're WASTING our time.'

items.sentence: 6  People say that UFOs ........................... in Myrrhee.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'to LAND' = qo'nmoq (kema/samolyot uchun).

110-bet, 2-kadr:
'They say UFOs LAND here in Myrrhee every
year.'

Ega 'UFOs' — KO'PLIK, shuning uchun -S
QO'SHILMAYDI.

⚠ ENG NOZIK BAND:
'What DOES it ... LIKE?'

'DOES' allaqachon III shaxs birlikni
ko'rsatadi, shuning uchun fe'l ASOSIY shaklda:
  'What does it LOOK like?'  ✓
  'What does it LOOKS like?' ✗

Ro'yxatda 'look' (-S siz) berilgani shuning
uchun.

110-bet, 5-kadr: 'It LOOKS LIKE a UFO.'

exercises.instructionEn: Listen to the episode and follow the dialogue. In pairs, read it out.
exercises.instructionUz: Epizodni tinglang va dialogni kuzating. Juftlikda uni ovoz chiqarib o'qing.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU MAShQ JAVOB TALAB QILMAYDI — bu
TALAFFUZ mashqi.

QANDAY BAJARILADI:
  1) Audioni tinglab, matnni ko'z bilan
     kuzating.
  2) Juftlikda rollarni bo'lib oling:
     biri SANDRA, biri DEVID.
  3) Ovoz chiqarib o'qing.


ROLLAR BO'YIChA GAPLAR:

 SANDRA:
  • David, do you believe in UFOs?
  • But some people say they have seen UFOs.
    They say UFOs land here in Myrrhee every
    year, during the first week of January.
  • What's the matter, David? Why are you
    slowing down?
  • David, where's that noise coming from?
  • What is that bright light?
  • What are those flashing lights?
  • They are taking us into the spaceship. Oh,
    I can't stand that noise. My ears ...

 DEVID:
  • Not really, I'm afraid we're wasting our
    time.
  • Well, I'm sure there's a logical
    explanation.
  • I'm not. I think that there is something
    wrong with the car. It's no use, I can't
    start it. What on earth is going on? This
    is a new car!
  • Sandra, look! Up there, in the sky!
  • It looks like a UFO. Quick! Take some
    pictures!
  • Look at it! It's huge!
  • I can't see anything. These lights are too
    bright.


TALAFFUZ UChUN DIQQAT:

  'UFO' — harflab o'qiladi: /ˌjuː efˈəʊ/
     'yu-ef-ou'
     Artikli 'A' (AN emas!), chunki 'yu'
     tovushi bilan boshlanadi:
        'A UFO'  ✓
        'AN UFO' ✗

  'Myrrhee' — /ˈmɪri/ ('miri')

  'huge' — /hjuːdʒ/ ('xyu:j')

  'noise' — /nɔɪz/ ('noyz')

  'spaceship' — /ˈspeɪsʃɪp/


OHANG (INTONATSIYA):
  • Savollarda ohang ko'tariladi:
       'Do you believe in UFOs? ↗'
  • Undov gaplarda kuchli va tez:
       'Look at it! It's huge!'
  • Devidning uzun gapida hayrat:
       'What ON EARTH is going on?'
       ('on earth' KUCHLI aytiladi)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to follow    = kuzatmoq, ergashmoq
  to read out  = ovoz chiqarib o'qimoq

points.en: SANDRA: David, do you believe in UFOs?  DAVID: Not really, I'm afraid we're wasting our time.
points.uz: SANDRA: Devid, NUJOlarga ishonasanmi? DEVID: Unchalik emas. Qo'rqamanki, vaqtimizni behuda o'tkazyapmiz.
points.noteUz:
Rollarni bo'lib o'qish uchun.

'UFO' harflab o'qiladi: 'yu-ef-ou'.
Artikli 'A UFO' ('an UFO' XATO).

points.en: SANDRA: What's the matter, David? Why are you slowing down?  DAVID: I'm not. I think that there is something wrong with the car.
points.uz: SANDRA: Nima bo'ldi, Devid? Nega sekinlashtiryapsan? DEVID: Sekinlashtirmayapman. Menimcha, mashinada nimadir noto'g'ri.
points.noteUz: Savollarda ohang KO'TARILADI.

points.en: DAVID: What on earth is going on? This is a new car!
points.uz: DEVID: Nima bo'lyapti o'zi? Bu yangi mashina-ku!
points.noteUz:
'ON EARTH' KUCHLI aytiladi — hayrat va
jahl bildiradi.

points.en: DAVID: Look at it! It's huge!  SANDRA: They are taking us into the spaceship. Oh, I can't stand that noise. My ears ...
points.uz: DEVID: Unga qara! Juda katta! SANDRA: Ular bizni kemaga olib kirishmoqda. Voy, bu shovqinga chidayolmayman. Quloqlarim...
points.noteUz:
Undov gaplar KUCHLI va TEZ aytiladi.
'huge' o'qilishi /hjuːdʒ/ ('xyu:j').

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the picture and label the parts of the jeep with words from the list. Then, describe the jeep.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmga qarang va jipning qismlarini ro'yxatdagi so'zlar bilan nomlang. So'ngra jipni tasvirlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (9 ta so'z, 9 ta belgi):
  bumper, steering wheel, headlight,
  windscreen, rear-view mirror, bonnet,
  wing mirror, seat, wheel


BARCHA JAVOBLAR (strelkalar bo'yicha):

  a  →  WINDSCREEN        (old oyna)
  b  →  REAR-VIEW MIRROR  (salon ko'zgusi)
  c  →  BONNET            (kapot)
  d  →  WING MIRROR       (yon ko'zgu)
  e  →  HEADLIGHT         (old chiroq)
  f  →  BUMPER            (bamper)
  g  →  SEAT              (o'rindiq)
  h  →  STEERING WHEEL    (rul)
  i  →  WHEEL             (g'ildirak)


STRELKALAR QAYERGA KO'RSATADI:

  a — pastga-o'ngga, kabinaning OLD OYNASIGA
  b — pastga-chapga, oyna tepasidagi kichik
      qora ko'zguga (SALON ko'zgusi)
  c — tik pastga, qizil KAPOTGA
  d — pastga-chapga, eshik ustunidagi YON
      KO'ZGUGA
  e — o'ngga, panjara ichidagi dumaloq
      CHIROQQA
  f — yuqoriga-o'ngga, oldingi pastki qora
      BAMPERGA
  g — yuqoriga-chapga, bej rangli
      O'RINDIQQA
  h — yuqoriga-chapga, salon ichidagi qora
      dumaloq RULGA
  i — yuqoriga-o'ngga, oldingi
      G'ILDIRAKKA


⚠ IKKI KO'ZGU FARQI — ENG NOZIK JOY:

  b — REAR-VIEW MIRROR (salon ko'zgusi)
      Oyna ICHIDA, tepada osilgan.
      'rear' = orqa; 'view' = ko'rinish
      → orqani ko'rish uchun

  d — WING MIRROR (yon ko'zgu)
      Kuzovning TAShQARISIDA, eshik yonida.
      'wing' = qanot (mashinaning yon qismi)
      Amerikada: 'side mirror'


⚠ IKKI 'WHEEL' FARQI:

  h — STEERING WHEEL (rul)
      'to steer' = boshqarmoq
      Salon ichida, haydovchi oldida.

  i — WHEEL (g'ildirak)
      Tashqarida, yerda.

  DIQQAT: 'wheel' o'zi = g'ildirak;
  'steering wheel' = rul.


BRITANCHA va AMERIKACHA FARQLARI:

  BRITANCHA          AMERIKACHA
  ─────────────      ──────────────
  windscreen         windshield
  bonnet             hood
  wing mirror        side mirror
  boot               trunk (yuk xonasi)
  bumper             bumper (bir xil)

  Enterprise — BRITANCHA kitob.


JIPNI TASVIRLASh (mashqning ikkinchi qismi):

  'The jeep is red. It has got a black
   BUMPER at the front and two round
   HEADLIGHTS. The BONNET is red. There is a
   large WINDSCREEN and a REAR-VIEW MIRROR
   inside. There is a WING MIRROR on each
   side. Inside, there is a STEERING WHEEL
   and four SEATS. The jeep has got four big
   WHEELS.'

  Tarjimasi:
  'Jip qizil rangda. Old tomonida qora bamper
   va ikkita dumaloq chiroq bor. Kapoti qizil.
   Katta old oyna va ichkarida salon ko'zgusi
   bor. Har ikki tomonda yon ko'zgu bor.
   Ichkarida rul va to'rtta o'rindiq bor.
   Jipning to'rtta katta g'ildiragi bor.'


TASVIRLASh QOLIPI:
  'It has got a/an [sifat] [qism].'
  'There is a [qism] at the front/inside.'
  'The [qism] is [rang].'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a bumper        = bamper
  a steering wheel = rul
  a headlight     = old chiroq
  a windscreen    = old oyna
  a rear-view mirror = salon ko'zgusi
  a bonnet        = kapot
  a wing mirror   = yon ko'zgu
  a seat          = o'rindiq
  a wheel         = g'ildirak
  to label        = nomlamoq
  to describe     = tasvirlamoq

pairs.whyUz:
Strelka kabinaning OLD OYNASIGA ko'rsatadi.

BRITANCHA: windscreen
AMERIKACHA: windshield

Strelka oyna ICHIDA, tepada osilgan kichik
qora ko'zguga ko'rsatadi.

'rear' = orqa; 'view' = ko'rinish
→ ORQANI ko'rish uchun.

⚠ 'd' (wing mirror) bilan ADASHTIRMANG!

Strelka TIK PASTGA, qizil KAPOTGA
ko'rsatadi.

BRITANCHA: bonnet
AMERIKACHA: hood

(Yuk xonasi: britancha 'boot',
amerikacha 'trunk'.)

Strelka kuzovning TASHQARISIDAGI, eshik
yonidagi ko'zguga ko'rsatadi.

'wing' = qanot (mashinaning yon qismi).
AMERIKACHA: side mirror

⚠ 'b' (rear-view mirror) bilan
ADASHTIRMANG: biri ICHKARIDA, biri
TASHQARIDA.

Strelka panjara ichidagi DUMALOQ CHIROQQA
ko'rsatadi.

'head' = old; 'light' = chiroq.

Orqa chiroq: 'a rear light' / 'a tail
light'.

Strelka oldingi ENG PASTKI qora bo'lakka
ko'rsatadi.

'to bump' = urilmoq → 'a bumper' = urilishdan
himoya qiluvchi qism.

Britancha va amerikachada BIR XIL.

Strelka salon ichidagi BEJ RANGLI
O'RINDIQQA ko'rsatadi.

'a seatbelt' = xavfsizlik kamari
(Workbook 58-bet).

Strelka salon ichidagi QORA DUMALOQ RULGA
ko'rsatadi.

'to steer' = boshqarmoq.

⚠ 'i' (wheel) bilan ADASHTIRMANG:
  steering wheel = RUL (ichkarida)
  wheel = G'ILDIRAK (tashqarida)

Strelka oldingi G'ILDIRAKKA (metall diskli)
ko'rsatadi.

'a wheel' = g'ildirak;
'a tyre' = shina (g'ildirakning rezinasi).

⚠ 'h' (steering wheel) bilan
ADASHTIRMANG.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the summary and fill in the missing prepositions from the list.
exercises.instructionUz: Xulosani o'qing va ro'yxatdan yetishmayotgan predloglarni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (6 ta predlog):
  down, through, of, in, into, near

DIQQAT: 7 ta bo'shliq, 6 ta so'z —
demak BITTASI IKKI marta ishlatiladi.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  THROUGH
  2  NEAR
  3  IN
  4  DOWN
  5  IN
  6  OF
  7  INTO

  'IN' IKKI marta (3 va 5).


TO'LIQ XULOSA (javoblar bilan):

  'David and Sandra are driving THROUGH the
   fields NEAR Myrrhee in Australia. David
   does not believe IN UFOs and he thinks
   there is a logical explanation. Suddenly
   the jeep slows DOWN and David can't start
   it again.

   Then Sandra sees a bright light IN the sky.
   It is a spaceship. David asks Sandra to
   take pictures OF the huge spaceship. David
   can't see anything because of the flashing
   lights and Sandra can't stand the noise.
   They are scared because the visitors are
   taking them INTO the spaceship.'


TO'LIQ TARJIMASI:

  'Devid va Sandra Avstraliyaning Myrrhee
   shahri yaqinidagi dalalar orasidan
   o'tishmoqda. Devid NUJOlarga ishonmaydi va
   uning fikricha, buning mantiqiy izohi bor.
   To'satdan jip sekinlashadi va Devid uni
   qaytadan yura olmaydi.

   So'ngra Sandra osmonda yorqin nurni
   ko'radi. Bu — kosmik kema. Devid Sandradan
   ulkan kemaning suratini olishni so'raydi.
   Devid miltillayotgan chiroqlar tufayli hech
   narsa ko'rmaydi, Sandra esa shovqinga
   chidayolmaydi. Ular qo'rqishmoqda, chunki
   mehmonlar ularni kemaga olib kirishmoqda.'


HAR BIRI NEGA — TURG'UN BIRIKMALAR:

 1  'driving THROUGH the fields'
    'through' = ichidan, orasidan
    (Kirish matnida ham: 'driving THROUGH the
     fields')

 2  'NEAR Myrrhee'
    'near' = yaqinida
    (Kirish matnida ham)

 3  'believe IN UFOs'
    'believe IN' — turg'un birikma
    (1-kadr: 'Do you believe IN UFOs?')

 4  'the jeep slows DOWN'
    'to slow DOWN' — turg'un fe'l
    (3-kadr: 'Why are you slowing DOWN?')

 5  'a bright light IN the sky'
    'IN the sky' — predlog 'in'
    (4-kadr: 'Up there, IN THE SKY!')

 6  'take pictures OF the spaceship'
    'take pictures OF' — turg'un birikma

 7  'taking them INTO the spaceship'
    'INTO' — ichkariga HARAKAT
    (7-kadr: 'taking us INTO the spaceship')


⚠ 'IN' va 'INTO' FARQI:

  IN   — JOY (harakatsiz)
     'a light IN the sky'
     'UFOs land IN Myrrhee'

  INTO — HARAKAT (ichkariga)
     'taking them INTO the spaceship'
     'push INTO a queue' (CB 100-bet)
     'bring pets INTO school' (CB 102-bet)


XULOSA MATNINING FOYDASI:
  Bu xulosa 2-mashqning javoblarini ham
  tasdiqlaydi:
     'SANDRA SEES a bright light'
        → 3-band = S
     'DAVID ASKS Sandra to take pictures'
        → 5-kadrni Devid aytgan
     'DAVID can't see anything ... SANDRA
      can't stand the noise'
        → 7-kadrdagi ikki gap kimniki ekani


DIQQAT — 'BECAUSE OF':
  'because OF the flashing lights'
  'because of' + OT (sabab)
  'because' + GAP

     'because OF the lights'   ✓ (ot)
     'because the lights are bright' ✓ (gap)
     'because of the lights are bright' ✗


DIQQAT — 'SCARED':
  'They are SCARED.' = ular qo'rqishmoqda
  'to be scared OF something' = ... dan
  qo'rqmoq (Workbook 59-bet).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a summary   = xulosa
  through     = orasidan, ichidan
  near        = yaqinida
  to slow down = sekinlashmoq
  because of  = ... tufayli
  scared      = qo'rqqan
  again       = qaytadan

items.sentence: 1  David and Sandra are driving .................... the fields
items.uz: Devid va Sandra dalalar orasidan o'tishmoqda

commonMistake.whyUz:
'to drive THROUGH' = orasidan/ichidan o'tmoq.

110-betdagi kirish matnida ham aynan shu:
'They are driving THROUGH the fields.'

'NEAR' = yaqinida.

Kirish matnidan: 'through the fields NEAR
Myrrhee in Australia'.

'to believe IN something' — turg'un birikma
(mavjudligiga ishonmoq).

110-bet, 1-kadr: 'Do you believe IN UFOs?'

DIQQAT: 'in' bu mashqda IKKI marta
ishlatiladi (3 va 5).

items.sentence: 4  Suddenly the jeep slows ................ and David can't start it again.
items.uz: To'satdan jip sekinlashadi va Devid uni qaytadan yura olmaydi.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'to slow DOWN' — turg'un fe'l
(sekinlashmoq).

110-bet, 3-kadr: 'Why are you slowing DOWN?'
Workbook 60-bet, 3-mashqda ham bor edi.

items.sentence: 5  Then Sandra sees a bright light ....................... the sky.
items.uz: So'ngra Sandra osmonda yorqin nurni ko'radi.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'IN the sky' — predlog 'in'.

110-bet, 4-kadr: 'Up there, IN THE SKY!'

⚠ 7-BAND BILAN SOLISHTIRING:
  IN   — JOY (harakatsiz)
  INTO — HARAKAT (ichkariga)

items.sentence: 6  David asks Sandra to take pictures ................ the huge spaceship.
items.uz: Devid Sandradan ulkan kemaning suratini olishni so'raydi.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'to take pictures OF something' — turg'un
birikma.

Grammar 62-bet, hayvonot bog'i dialogi:
'Can we take pictures OF the animals?'

'take pictures FOR' — XATO.

items.sentence: 7  They are scared because the visitors are taking them ................ the spaceship.
items.uz: Ular qo'rqishmoqda, chunki mehmonlar ularni kemaga olib kirishmoqda.

commonMistake.whyUz:
'INTO' — ichkariga HARAKAT.

110-bet, 7-kadr: 'They are taking us INTO
the spaceship.'

⚠ 5-BAND BILAN FARQI:
  'IN the sky' — JOY (harakatsiz)
  'INTO the spaceship' — HARAKAT

Shu kabi: 'push INTO a queue' (CB 100-bet).

exercises.instructionEn: Read the list of events and put them in the correct order.
exercises.instructionUz: Voqealar ro'yxatini o'qing va ularni to'g'ri tartibga soling.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'G'RI TARTIB:

  1  David and Sandra are driving through the
     fields near Myrrhee.   (KITOBDA 1 QO'YILGAN)
  2  Sandra hears a noise.
  3  They see a bright light in the sky.
  4  Sandra takes pictures.
  5  The visitors are taking them into the
     spaceship.


KITOBDAGI TARTIB (yuqoridan pastga) va
TO'G'RI RAQAMI:

  'The visitors are taking them into the
   spaceship.'                          → 5
  'Sandra hears a noise.'                → 2
  'David and Sandra are driving through
   the fields near Myrrhee.'             → 1
  'Sandra takes pictures.'               → 4
  'They see a bright light in the sky.'  → 3


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — 110-BETDAGI KADRLAR
KETMA-KETLIGI:

  1-2-kadr:  jipda suhbat (haydashyapti)
             → 1
  3-kadr:    'where's that NOISE coming
             from?'
             → 2 (shovqin)
  4-kadr:    'What is that BRIGHT LIGHT?'
             → 3 (nur)
  5-kadr:    'Take some PICTURES!'
             → 4 (surat)
  7-kadr:    'They are taking us INTO the
             SPACESHIP.'
             → 5 (kemaga olib kirish)


⚠ MANTIQIY ZANJIR:

  haydash → shovqin → nur → surat → olib
  kirish

  Har bosqich oldingisidan kelib chiqadi:
     avval shovqin eshitiladi (manba
        ko'rinmaydi)
     keyin nur ko'rinadi (manba topiladi)
     keyin surat olinadi (dalil)
     oxirida ular olib ketiladi


ZAMONLAR:
  Voqealarning ba'zisi Present Continuous da
  ('are driving', 'are taking'), ba'zisi
  Present Simple da ('hears', 'see', 'takes').

  Ikkalasi ham 'dramatik hozirgi zamon' —
  hikoyani jonli qilish uchun.


DIQQAT — 'HEARS' va 'SEE':
  'Sandra HEARS a noise.' — ega BIRLIK → -S
  'THEY SEE a bright light.' — ega KO'PLIK
     → -S YO'Q
  'Sandra TAKES pictures.' — ega BIRLIK → -S


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an event    = voqea
  in the correct order = to'g'ri tartibda

points.en: 1  David and Sandra are driving through the fields near Myrrhee.
points.uz: 1  Devid va Sandra Myrrhee yaqinidagi dalalar orasidan o'tishmoqda.
points.noteUz:
KITOBDA 1 QO'YILGAN (namuna).
110-bet, kirish matni va 1-2-kadrlar.

points.en: 2  Sandra hears a noise.
points.uz: 2  Sandra shovqin eshitadi.
points.noteUz:
110-bet, 3-kadr:
'David, where's that NOISE coming from?'

DIQQAT: 'Sandra HEARS' — ega BIRLIK → -S.

points.en: 3  They see a bright light in the sky.
points.uz: 3  Ular osmonda yorqin nurni ko'rishadi.
points.noteUz:
110-bet, 4-kadr:
'What is that BRIGHT LIGHT?'

DIQQAT: 'THEY SEE' — ega KO'PLIK → -S YO'Q.

points.en: 4  Sandra takes pictures.
points.uz: 4  Sandra surat oladi.
points.noteUz:
110-bet, 5-kadr:
'Quick! TAKE SOME PICTURES!'

8-mashqdagi xulosa: 'David asks SANDRA to
take pictures' — demak suratni SANDRA oladi.

points.en: 5  The visitors are taking them into the spaceship.
points.uz: 5  Mehmonlar ularni kemaga olib kirishmoqda.
points.noteUz:
110-bet, 7-kadr (oxirgi):
'They are taking us INTO the spaceship.'

⚠ MANTIQIY ZANJIR:
haydash → shovqin → nur → surat → olib
kirish.

exercises.instructionEn: What do you think will happen to David and Sandra?
exercises.instructionUz: Sizningcha, Devid va Sandraga nima bo'ladi?
exercises.explanationUz:
BU — OChIQ SAVOL (bashorat).

Javob har kimda BOShQA bo'ladi — o'z
fikringizni ayting.


⚠ QAYSI ZAMON IShLATILADI:

  Savol 'What do you think WILL HAPPEN?'
  deb berilgan → javob ham WILL bilan.

  WILL — DALILSIZ bashorat (Unit 13 dan).

  QOLIP:
     'I think they WILL ...'
     'I think they WON'T ...'
     'Maybe they WILL ...'
     'Perhaps the aliens WILL ...'


NAMUNA JAVOBLAR:

 1  'I think the aliens WILL TAKE them to
     another planet.'
    (Menimcha, o'zga sayyoraliklar ularni
     boshqa sayyoraga olib ketadi.)

 2  'I think they WILL ESCAPE and WRITE a
     story about the UFO.'
    (Menimcha, ular qochib qutuladi va NUJO
     haqida maqola yozadi.)

 3  'I don't think the aliens WILL HURT them.
     They WILL LET them go.'
    (Menimcha, o'zga sayyoraliklar ularga
     zarar yetkazmaydi. Ularni qo'yib
     yuboradi.)

 4  'Maybe they WILL WAKE UP in the jeep and
     they WON'T REMEMBER anything.'
    (Balki ular jipda uyg'onadi va hech
     narsani eslay olmaydi.)

 5  'I think the aliens WILL ERASE their
     memories.'
    (Menimcha, o'zga sayyoraliklar ularning
     xotiralarini o'chiradi.)

    ⚠ Workbook 60-bet, 3-mashqning 6-bandi
    AYNAN shu edi:
    'The aliens ERASED their memories.'

    Demak bu — kitobning O'ZI bergan ishora!


⚠ ENG ISHONChLI BAShORAT:

  Workbook 60-betdagi 3-mashqning 6-bandi:
     'The ALIENS ERASED their MEMORIES.'

  Bu gap bejiz emas — kitob keyingi
  epizodning mazmuniga ishora qilgan
  bo'lishi mumkin.


BAShORAT UChUN FOYDALI IBORALAR:

  ISHONChLI:
     'I think ... will ...'
     'I'm sure ... will ...'

  ShUBHALI:
     'Maybe ... will ...'
     'Perhaps ... will ...'
     'I don't think ... will ...'

  DIQQAT: inkorda 'I DON'T THINK ... will'
  (Unit 14 dagi qoida — inkor BOSH gapga).


DIQQAT — 'HAPPEN TO':
  'What will HAPPEN TO David and Sandra?'
  'to happen TO somebody' = birovga
  (biror voqea) sodir bo'lmoq

  Workbook 59-bet: 'I'm afraid it will
  HAPPEN again.'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to happen to = ... ga sodir bo'lmoq
  an alien     = o'zga sayyoralik
  a planet     = sayyora
  to escape    = qochib qutulmoq
  to hurt      = zarar yetkazmoq
  to let go    = qo'yib yubormoq
  to wake up   = uyg'onmoq
  to remember  = eslamoq
  to erase     = o'chirib tashlamoq
  a memory     = xotira

points.en: I think the aliens will take them to another planet.
points.uz: Menimcha, o'zga sayyoraliklar ularni boshqa sayyoraga olib ketadi.
points.noteUz:
OCHIQ savol — bashorat.
Savolda 'WILL happen' bor → javobda ham WILL.

WILL — dalilsiz bashorat (Unit 13).

points.en: I think they will escape and write a story about the UFO.
points.uz: Menimcha, ular qochib qutuladi va NUJO haqida maqola yozadi.
points.noteUz:
Ular tadqiqotchi va maqola yozish uchun
kelishgan edi — bu mantiqiy davomi.

points.en: I don't think the aliens will hurt them. They will let them go.
points.uz: Menimcha, o'zga sayyoraliklar ularga zarar yetkazmaydi. Ularni qo'yib yuboradi.
points.noteUz:
INKOR bashorat:
'I DON'T THINK ... will ...' ✓
(inkor BOSH gapga — Unit 14 qoidasi).

points.en: I think the aliens will erase their memories.
points.uz: Menimcha, o'zga sayyoraliklar ularning xotiralarini o'chiradi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ ENG ISHONCHLI BASHORAT:

Workbook 60-bet, 3-mashqning 6-bandi AYNAN
shu edi:
'The ALIENS ERASED their MEMORIES.'

Kitobning O'ZI bergan ishora!

points.en: Maybe they will wake up in the jeep and they won't remember anything.
points.uz: Balki ular jipda uyg'onadi va hech narsani eslay olmaydi.
points.noteUz:
'Maybe ... will ...' — shubhali bashorat.
'won't' = will not.
INKOR gapda 'ANYTHING' ('nothing' EMAS).

patterns.formula: What DOES it LOOK LIKE?   (does dan keyin ASOSIY shakl)
patterns.exampleEn: What does it look like? — It looks like a UFO.
patterns.explanationUz:
'does' allaqachon III shaxs birlikni
ko'rsatadi → fe'l ASOSIY shaklda.
'What does it LOOKS like?' — XATO.

patterns.formula: The jeep HAS GOT a/an + [sifat] + [qism].   /   There IS a + [qism] + at the front / inside.
patterns.exampleEn: The jeep has got a black bumper at the front and two round headlights. There is a steering wheel inside.
patterns.exampleUz: Jipning old tomonida qora bamper va ikkita dumaloq chiroq bor. Ichkarida rul bor.
patterns.explanationUz:
Mashinani tasvirlash qolipi.
'has got' — britancha ('has' ham to'g'ri).

patterns.formula: ... IN the sky   (JOY)   ↔   ... INTO the spaceship   (HARAKAT)
patterns.exampleEn: Sandra sees a bright light in the sky. The visitors are taking them into the spaceship.
patterns.exampleUz: Sandra osmonda yorqin nurni ko'radi. Mehmonlar ularni kemaga olib kirishmoqda.
patterns.explanationUz:
IN — harakatsiz JOY;
INTO — ichkariga HARAKAT.

patterns.formula: I THINK ... WILL + [ASOSIY fe'l].   /   I DON'T THINK ... WILL + [fe'l].
patterns.exampleEn: I think the aliens will erase their memories. I don't think the aliens will hurt them.
patterns.exampleUz: Menimcha, o'zga sayyoraliklar xotiralarini o'chiradi. Menimcha, ularga zarar yetkazmaydi.
patterns.explanationUz:
BASHORAT — WILL (dalilsiz taxmin).
Inkor BOSH gapga: 'I DON'T think ... will'.
